svg.text: top view · hat mounts over the west half (180° vs the carrier) · carrier sockets on the bottom side, east
J8 — audio to the hat (mates hat J7)
signals outer, grounds between = crosstalk guard
powered + driven from this board — hat J6 not needed
PASS_B2 = the carrier’s main 5 V rail (a legitimate power tap).
PASS_B4 = the carrier’s 3V3_EN — NEVER ground it.
+5V is injected by the buck onto the carrier’s pre-mux node — USB-C data works while rack-powered.
Pinout follows the hat’s 2026-08 dual-host revision (see hat repo).
